research_question: Does candidate- and metric-conditioned reading of frozen spatial visual tokens reduce NC/DAC-related selection errors compared with an equal-parameter shared visual reader?

preregistered_gate.primary: Metric-specific minus shared selected PDMS has a positive paired recording-bootstrap 95% lower bound on the separate 192 development scenes
preregistered_gate.secondary: Metric-specific selected collision/offroad rate exceeds neither shared nor unchanged by more than one percentage point
preregistered_gate.interpretation: Passing supports replication, not independent test superiority; failure does not trigger a larger experiment

evaluation_scope: Previously used NAVVAL development recordings; not independent final NAVTEST
